    WHAT YOU'RE TRYING

    A transparent prototype.

    01 / THIS SITE

    Browser simulation

    Deterministic sample appointments, local draft storage with failure notices, explicit approval, duplicate prevention, and full-detail record verification. Data stays in this browser.

    02 / THE BACKEND

    Download the implementation

    The v0.4 Python project includes a self-hosted MCP server, SQLite drafts, and an adapter targeting Easy!Appointments 1.6.

    Download backend source ZIP ↗
    03 / VALIDATION

    117 recorded tests

    The earlier backend release recorded 117 passing automated tests with controlled sources. Native Alexa, a live booking service, and real-user validation remain next steps.

    This hosted demonstration is not connected to native Alexa, live MCP, or a real booking provider. The submitted film is an earlier automated walkthrough of the same sample flow. The current demo additionally checks all approved details and reports storage failures. It does not show a live Alexa session.
